coverage_gap.conclusion: Public data close the geometry, force-capacity and rate-coding side of the model. The electrode-geometry side (volume-conduction length, action-potential duration, absolute EMG amplitude scale) is NOT closed by any admitted dataset and needs measured bipolar surface EMG with a documented electrode-to-muscle distance and a stated amplitude unit.
